name: Flow to the left, V0 = −1.5
setup: IC 2 with flow to the left, V0 = −1.5. Training only contained flow to the right (V0 > 0).
expect: Physically this is just IC 2 mirrored, so a perfect model would be equally good. A network that never saw left-moving flow has no reason to know that.
observed: With the paper's network both versions lose accuracy (h error 1.7–1.9%, q about 4%); the identical waves moving right (V0 = +1.5) give h errors of only 0.09% (NN) and 0.21% (MCL-NN). Switch the network to the mirror-symmetric MLP: q error drops to 0.36% (NN) and 0.69% (MCL-NN), because that network knows mirrored flows have mirrored fluxes.
